'''Tarin DeHallo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] assistant manager of the [[Marqua Spas]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Gailea]]. She booked [[Jantaa Binx]], a practitioner of the [[Floubette dance]], to perform at the [[Marqua Spas Grand Ball]] without realizing Binx was [[Human/Legends|Human]]. The resulting shocking display&mdash;as the Floubette dance was an aesthetically pleasing, idealized form of the [[Floubettean/Legends|Floubettean]] [[Reproduction/Legends|mating]] ritual that was traditionally performed by [[Bird/Legends|avian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]&mdash;led to her dismissal.
